title: A five-point reduction
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator behind percentage points.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator behind percentage points affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator behind percentage points in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
